story.text: 변산반도 해변 캠핑장에 도착하자, 파도 소리가 은은하게 들려왔다. 짐을 내리며 하늘이 팔을 걷어붙였다.
story.reading: byeon-san-ban-do hae-byeon kaem-ping-jang-e do-chak-ha-ja, pa-do so-ri-ga eun-eun-ha-ge deul-lyeo-wat-da. jim-eul nae-ri-myeo ha-neul-i pal-eul geod-eo-but-yeot-da.
story.en: We arrived at the beachside campsite on Byeonsan Peninsula, and the sound of waves drifted in softly. As we unloaded our things, Haneul rolled up his sleeves.

story.text: "텐트 치는 거 처음이지? 보고만 있어." 그는 능숙한 손놀림으로 순식간에 텐트를 쳤다. 나는 감탄하며 옆에서 폴대만 건넸다.
story.reading: ten-teu chi-neun geo cheo-eum-i-ji? bo-go-man iss-eo. geu-neun neung-suk-han son-nol-lim-eu-ro sun-sik-gan-e ten-teu-reul chyeot-da. na-neun gam-tan-ha-myeo yeop-e-seo pol-dae-man geon-net-da.
story.en: "First time pitching a tent, right? Just watch." With practiced hands, he had the tent up in no time. I just handed him tent poles, watching in awe.

story.text: 그가 근처에서 주워 온 장작을 착착 쌓기 시작했다. "젖은 건 안 타. 마른 것만 골라." 나름의 노하우를 알려주는 그의 표정은 진지했다.
story.reading: geu-ga geun-cheo-e-seo ju-wo on jang-jag-eul chak-chak ssah-gi si-jak-haet-da. jeoj-eun geon an ta. ma-reun geot-man gol-la. na-reum-ui no-ha-u-reul al-lyeo-ju-neun geu-ui pyo-jeong-eun jin-ji-haet-da.
story.en: He started neatly stacking firewood he'd gathered nearby. "Wet ones won't burn. Pick only the dry ones." His expression was serious as he shared his own know-how.

story.text: 라이터 불꽃이 장작에 옮겨붙으며 모닥불이 타올랐다. 어두워진 캠핑장에 주황빛이 은은하게 번졌다.
story.reading: ra-i-teo bul-kkoch-i jang-jag-e om-gyeo-but-eu-myeo mo-dak-bul-i ta-ol-lat-da. eo-du-wo-jin kaem-ping-jang-e ju-hwang-bich-i eun-eun-ha-ge beon-jyeot-da.
story.en: The lighter's flame caught the firewood, and the campfire blazed to life. A warm orange glow spread softly through the darkened campsite.

story.text: 우리는 나란히 앉아 말없이 불꽃만 바라봤다. "이게 그렇게 유명한 불멍이라는 거야." 하늘이 낮게 중얼거렸다. 아무 생각 없이 멍하니 있는 시간이 오랜만이었다.
story.reading: u-ri-neun na-ran-hi anj-a mal-eop-si bul-kkot-man ba-ra-bwat-da. i-ge geu-reo-ke yu-myeong-han bul-meong-i-ra-neun geo-ya. ha-neul-i naj-ge jung-eol-geo-ryeot-da. a-mu saeng-gak eop-si meong-ha-ni it-neun si-gan-i o-raen-man-i-eot-da.
story.en: We sat side by side, silently staring at the flames. "So this is the famous 'bulmeong' thing," Haneul murmured low. It had been a long time since I'd let my mind go blank like this.

story.text: 고개를 들자 별이 쏟아질 듯 빼곡했다. "저게 무슨 별자리인지 알아?" 내가 묻자, 그는 잠시 생각하더니 시치미를 뗐다. "몰라. 그냥 예쁘다는 것만 알아."
story.reading: go-gae-reul deul-ja byeol-i ssod-a-jil deut ppae-gok-haet-da. jeo-ge mu-seun byeol-ja-ri-in-ji al-a? nae-ga mut-ja, geu-neun jam-si saeng-gak-ha-deo-ni si-chi-mi-reul ttyeot-da. mol-la. geu-nyang ye-ppeu-da-neun geot-man al-a.
story.en: I looked up, and the sky was packed with stars, as if they might spill over. "Do you know what constellation that is?" I asked, and after a pause he played dumb. "No idea. I just know it's pretty."

story.text: 불이 사그라들 때까지 우리는 별다른 말 없이 그 자리에 머물렀다. 조용한 밤이었지만, 마음은 어느 때보다 편안했다.
story.reading: bul-i sa-geu-ra-deul ttae-kka-ji u-ri-neun byeol-da-reun mal eop-si geu ja-ri-e meo-mul-leot-da. jo-yong-han bam-i-eot-ji-man, ma-eum-eun eo-neu ttae-bo-da pyeon-an-haet-da.
story.en: We stayed there without much conversation until the fire burned low. It was a quiet night, but my heart felt more at ease than it ever had.

words.example_en: We worked together to pitch the tent.
We were low on firewood so we gathered more.
The romance of camping is staring at the fire.
I tried counting the constellations in the night sky.
We sat gathered around the campfire.
